It features a narcotic white floral heart of tuberose, brightened by fruity pear and anchored by dark, earthy patchouli. This striking contrast creates a highly memorable scent profile, perfect for both daytime empowerment and evening allure.

The tart freshness of litchi and rhubarb perfectly balances a lush, dewy heart of Turkish rose and peony. It is a radiant, compliment-getting signature scent ideal for spring and summer.

A decadent blend of dark orchids, ylang-ylang, and sweet fruits sits over a dark, earthy base of patchouli and incense. This powerful scent is a highly affordable yet sophisticated option for elegant evenings and formal events.

name: BRUT ORIGINAL EDT
description: Brut Original is an absolute titan of masculine perfumery, famously defining the aromatic fougere genre with its incredibly distinct and powerful DNA. The iconic blend of sharp lavender, spicy anise, and deep oakmoss provides an unmistakably clean and authoritative aura. It remains a timeless, highly respected classic that every gentleman should experience.

name: BRUTUS BRONZINO EDP
description: Brioni Brutus Bronzino is a masterfully tailored woody floral musk that drapes the wearer in elegant notes of violet, cedar, and smooth musk. Created for the sophisticated, modern gentleman, it embodies the luxury of a bespoke Italian suit. This powdery and refined scent is a staple for formal business settings.

name: BUBBLY EDP
description: Fragrance World Bubbly is a warm and spiced amber vanilla eau de parfum for all genders, launched in 2024. An intriguing opening of incense, tobacco, and saffron creates a smoky and resinous first impression before spiced elemi and cedarwood add woody, resinous depth in the heart. The fragrance resolves into a smooth and indulgent base of vanilla, tonka bean, and benzoin with lasting sweetness.

name: BUERBBERY BODY
description: Inspired by elegant classics, this chypre fruity fragrance offers a sophisticated and sensual experience. Formulated for the modern woman, it perfectly balances powdery iris, soft peach, and warm cashmere wood. This versatile scent is equally suited for professional settings and intimate evening encounters.

name: BUJAIRAMI AHLA SABIYEH
description: Delight in the youthful exuberance of Bujairami Ahla Sabiyeh, a charming and delightfully sweet fragrance that radiates happiness. Blending luscious fruits with a soft heart of white florals and a comforting vanilla-musk base, it is perfect for the cheerful, optimistic woman. An excellent daily driver, this uplifting scent is ideal for casual hangouts, shopping trips, and daytime socializing.

name: BUJAIRAMI BOOZ EXREME
description: Bujairami Booz Extreme is a wildly intoxicating gourmand fragrance centered around a rich, photorealistic cognac note. The boozy opening perfectly blends with decadent praline, sweet vanilla, and toasted oak for a truly addictive aroma. This exceptionally warm, long-lasting scent is a guaranteed compliment-getter for romantic date nights and cozy winter evenings.

name: BUJAIRAMI BOUJEE
description: Bujairami Boujee is a deeply intoxicating amber vanilla fragrance overflowing with boozy rum, sweet peach, and creamy sandalwood. Targeted at those who want to smell expensive, bold, and utterly delectable, it is a true gourmand powerhouse. This loud and sweet scent is exactly what you need for a memorable night out.

name: BUJAIRAMI CHROMA EDP
description: Bujairami Chroma is a brilliant citrus aromatic bursting with lemon and refreshing green tea. Its clean musk and sandalwood base caters to those seeking a bright, uplifting signature. Perfect for a crisp, energetic start to the day.

name: BUJAIRAMI COSMIC FEVER EDP
description: Bujairami Cosmic Fever is an electrifying floral gourmand designed for those who love to shine. Juicy pear and exotic orchid blend with a rich, addictive praline and patchouli base. It is a fun, vibrant, and incredibly sweet fragrance perfect for parties and night outs.

name: BUJAIRAMI DATE NIGHT
description: Bujairami Date Night is an incredibly seductive, dark fragrance that brilliantly contrasts sweet, juicy cherry with tough, smoky leather. The romantic rose heart is deeply intensified by warm vanilla and amber, ensuring a deeply alluring and mysterious sillage. As the name suggests, it is the ultimate secret weapon for unforgettable, romantic evenings.

name: BUJAIRAMI DRIP NO�7 EXTRAIT
description: Bujairami Drip No 7 Extrait is a luxurious and potent oriental floral fragrance known for its incredible longevity. Designed for men and women who want to leave a lasting impression, it features an intoxicating blend of saffron, almond, and ambergris. It is the ultimate statement fragrance for exclusive evening events.

id: BUJAIRAMI EXECUTOR EXTRAIT DE PARFUM 100 ML
name: BUJAIRAMI EXECUTOR EXTRAIT DE PARFUM
description: Bujairami Executor Extrait is a masterful chypre fruity scent combining bright pineapple and smoky birch. Its rich oakmoss and ambergris base appeals to the confident, ambitious leader. An exceptional, long-lasting signature for daily wear.

variants.key: BUJAIRAMI EXECUTOR EXTRAIT DE PARFUM 100 ML

name: BUJAIRAMI HECTIC EDP
description: Bujairami Hectic is a vibrant woody aquatic fragrance that delivers an instant burst of refreshing energy. Tailored for active individuals, it blends cool mint and citrus with marine notes and a clean ambergris finish. This highly versatile scent is ideal for gym sessions, sports, and casual summer days.

name: BUJAIRAMI HELOU EDP
description: Bujairami Helou is a delightful gourmand fragrance that radiates joy and sweetness. Appealing to lovers of rich, dessert-like scents, it beautifully combines sweet berries with creamy caramel and vanilla. It is a fantastic choice for casual everyday wear and relaxed social gatherings.

name: BUJAIRAMI HIGH ROLLER EDP
description: Bujairami High Roller is a bold, attention-grabbing woody spicy scent made for confident men. A fresh grapefruit and mint opening quickly yields to a fiery cinnamon and leather core. This powerful, long-lasting fragrance is the ultimate choice for a memorable night out.

name: BUJAIRAMI HOUDINI
description: Bujairami Houdini is an alluring and mysterious amber vanilla fragrance for those who want to stand out. The intriguing mix of cardamom and coffee creates a warm, addictive heart. Its smooth vanilla and sandalwood finish ensures a magical, long-lasting presence on cold winter nights.

name: BUJAIRAMI INFERNO
description: Bujairami Inferno is a highly potent, unapologetically fiery fragrance built upon an incredibly intense base of rich tobacco and dark leather. The aggressive opening of pink pepper and cinnamon ensures maximum projection and character. This bold, masculine masterpiece is specifically designed for the confident man who wishes to dominate the room.

name: BUJAIRAMI MADAM EDP
description: Bujairami Madam is a fiercely independent and elegant chypre floral fragrance that commands respect with its bright, zesty citrus opening. The romantic heart of rose and jasmine is beautifully grounded by a strong, sophisticated patchouli and vetiver base. This incredibly chic, long-lasting scent is the perfect versatile signature for the modern, successful woman.

name: BUJAIRAMI MAFIA BOSS EDP
description: BUJAIRAMI BUJAIRAMI MAFIA BOSS is a captivating fragrance from the Woody Spicy family that opens with refreshing notes of Apple, Bergamot. It perfectly balances a heart of Cinnamon, Geranium with a rich base of Vanilla, Sandalwood, creating an unforgettable Fruity-Spicy accord. Ideal for Office, Daily, this scent appeals to those seeking elegance and sophistication. Experience the finest craftsmanship with this exquisite perfume from Germany.

name: BUJAIRAMI MOJITO SPLASH EXTRAIT
description: Bujairami Mojito Splash Extrait is a vibrant citrus aromatic inspired by the classic cocktail. Its refreshing mint and lime blend targets those seeking a summer escape. The perfect companion for hot, casual days.

name: BUJAIRAMI MYSTERIOUS EDP
description: Bujairami Mysterious is a dark and captivating fragrance that opens with sharp black pepper and zesty bergamot. A luxurious heart of rose and saffron leads into a profound, long-lasting base of oud and amber. This powerful, exotic scent is designed for evening wear and making a bold, unforgettable statement.

id: BUJAIRAMI NEXT LEVEL EXTRAIT DE PARFUM

description: Bujairami Next Level Extrait De Parfum is a bold and intense fragrance featuring zesty citrus, pink pepper, and rich oud. It targets modern fragrance connoisseurs seeking a potent and long-lasting signature scent. Perfect for evening wear and special occasions, it leaves a powerful, unforgettable impression.

name: BUJAIRAMI NO LIMIT
description: Bujairami No Limit is a bold, energetic fragrance that starts with a vibrant, fruity blast of apple and bergamot. The sophisticated heart of rose and patchouli ensures a long-lasting, powerful trail that refuses to be ignored. Designed for those who push boundaries, it is an excellent scent for night outs and leaving a lasting impression.

name: BUJAIRAMI NUCLEAR EDP
description: Bujairami Nuclear is a massively powerful, room-filling fragrance that opens with a wildly intense blast of fresh, spicy citrus. The heavy dose of ambroxan in the base guarantees incredibly explosive projection and longevity that easily lasts all day and night. It is the ultimate attention-grabbing scent, strictly designed for clubbing and making a massive statement.

name: BUJAIRAMI SOVEREIGN

The rich birch tar and oakmoss base provides a masculine depth and incredible lasting power. This versatile fragrance is highly recommended as a reliable, compliment-getting signature scent for any occasion.

name: BUJAIRAMI TENFOLD
description: Bujairami Tenfold is an intensely powerful and highly concentrated fragrance that explodes with a spicy, fruity blast of cinnamon and crisp apple. An exceptionally rich and opulent heart of saffron and dark rose delivers a remarkably bold and commanding presence. The deeply resinous base of heavy oud and amber guarantees a monumental, room-filling sillage that lasts an incredibly long time.

name: BUJAIRAMI THE ROCK POWERFULLY

name: BUJAIRAMI THE SHEIKH EDP
description: Bujairami The Sheikh is a massively powerful, regal fragrance that perfectly embodies the ultimate luxury of traditional Arabian perfumery. The incredibly rich, classic combination of premium oud and sweet rose is flawlessly enhanced by spicy saffron and warm amber. This dominating, ultra-long-lasting scent is strictly reserved for highly formal occasions and commanding absolute respect.

name: BUJAIRAMI TOO DAMN GOOD EXTRAIT
description: Bujairami Too Damn Good Extrait is a potent, crowd-pleasing, and highly versatile chypre fruity fragrance. Inspired by legendary men's perfumery, it features an irresistible blend of fresh, juicy apple backed by a masculine, smoky birch and ambergris base. This high-performance, magnetic scent is the perfect signature for literally any occasion.

name: BUJAIRAMI UNFORGETTABLE EDP
description: Bujairami Unforgettable is a deeply sensual and addictive amber floral gourmand. The rich harmony of coffee, almond, and lush white florals creates a bold, feminine statement. Its decadent cacao and tonka bean dry down guarantees an unforgettable impression on romantic evenings.

name: BUJAIRAMI WHEN IN ROME
description: Bujairami When in Rome is an incredibly bright, highly uplifting fragrance that perfectly balances crisp, tart fruits with a deeply comforting vanilla base. The floral heart adds a wonderfully elegant touch to this highly crowd-pleasing profile. It is the perfect, joyful choice for daytime wear, easily bringing a touch of Mediterranean sunshine to any occasion.

name: BUJAIRAMI WICKED
description: Bujairami Wicked is a daring and seductive amber floral fragrance bursting with addictive notes of almond, tuberose, and roasted cacao. Targeted at the bold and glamorous woman, it is designed to turn heads and leave a lasting impression. Wear this sweet and intoxicating scent on a night out to feel truly unstoppable.

name: BUKHOOR AHLAM AL ARAB 80 GM
description: Bukhoor Ahlam Al Arab by Ard Al Zafaran offers a beautiful home fragrance experience featuring a sweet blend of rose, fruits, and cedarwood. Ideal for those who love inviting and uplifting Arabic incenses, it creates a warm, hospitable environment. Burn this lovely bakhoor to refresh your living space daily.

name: BUKHOOR AMWAJ 80 GM

It is highly recommended for families who enjoy rich, gourmand, and inviting Middle Eastern incenses. Use this sweet bakhoor to create a joyful, warm, and cozy atmosphere in your living space.

name: BUKHOOR BINT HOORAN 80GM

description: Suroori Bukhoor Oud Al Lail is a delightfully sweet and rich incense that completely transforms any room.
